description: Connect ChatGPT to Twelve Data for current and historical market information. Look up prices, time series, technical indicators, company fundamentals, earnings, dividends, market movers, analyst data, regulatory filings, and reference data for stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, forex, crypto, and commodities. Users authenticate with their own Twelve Data account, so available data and rate limits follow their plan. Market data is informational and is not investment advice.

defaultPrompt: Get the latest quote and today's change for a stock AAPL
Show daily time series for AAPL for the last 30 days
What is the RSI for TSLA?
